name: Hashline Edit
description: Hash-anchored line editing tools inspired by Oh My Pi Hashline.

tools.name: read_hashline
tools.title: Read Hashline File
tools.description: Read a text file with line numbers and a content hash tag for hashline_edit anchors.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace cwd.

offset.description: 1-indexed line number to start reading from.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

promptGuidelines: Use before hashline_edit; copy the [path#TAG] header and visible line numbers exactly.

tools.name: hashline_edit
tools.title: Hashline Edit
tools.description: Apply hash-anchored line edits to existing text files. Sections start with [PATH#TAG], followed by SWAP, DEL, INS.PRE, INS.POST, INS.HEAD, or INS.TAIL operations.

input.description:
Hashline patch text. Example: [src/app.ts#A1B2]
SWAP 3.=3:
+new line

promptGuidelines: Only edit lines shown by read_hashline for the matching [path#TAG]. Re-read after each successful edit because tags and line numbers change.
